parsed.result_reading: The robot falls forward in 3 of 4 seeds (median fall time 8.21 s, time_upright 8.56 s). Forward lean is high: pitch_mean 0.133 rad (above healthy [0.01,0.115]), pitch_end 0.781 rad, pitch_rate_mean 0.121 rad/s (above healthy [-0.001,0.015]), pitch_rate_end 1.716 rad/s. COM velocity at end is 0.78 m/s forward, step length over leg length is low at 0.079 (healthy [0.157,0.231]), double support fraction is high at 0.078 (healthy [0.009,0.059]), flight fraction high at 0.012 (healthy [0.0045,0.0067]). Capture point is consistently outside the support interval: capture_margin_over_L_mean -0.062 (healthy [-0.169,0.009]), com_ahead_of_cop_over_L_mean 0.014 (healthy [-0.001,0.010]), indicating a forward toppling moment. Angular momentum is elevated (angmom_norm_mean 0.0054 vs healthy [0.0005,0.0016]). Friction utilisation is high (p95 0.431 vs healthy [0.169,0.336]) while slip is negligible. Froude number is low at 0.0067 (healthy [0.012,0.036]), reflecting insufficient dynamic scaling. Foot-to-leg ratio is 0.166 (reference 0.267), suggesting a short support base. No joint torque saturation is observed.

parsed.result_reading: The robot consistently falls forward (pitch ~0.78 rad, pitch_rate ~1.7 rad/s) after ~8.2 s of upright time. Forward lean places the COM ahead of the centre of pressure (com_ahead_of_cop_over_L_mean=+0.014, com_ahead_of_cop_over_L_end=+0.232) driving the capture point outside the support interval (capture_margin_over_L_mean=-0.062, capture_margin_over_L_end=-0.44). This yields a negative capture margin and forward toppling moment. Walking metrics are poor: time_upright=8.56 s (<healthy 10 s), com_vx_mean=0.24 m/s (<healthy 0.24-0.53), step_length_over_L=0.079 (<healthy 0.157-0.231), double_support_fraction=0.078 (>healthy 0.009-0.059), flight_fraction=0.012 (>healthy 0.0045-0.0067). Increasing foot length (x1.2) worsened stability: falls rose from 3 to 4, time_upright dropped to 6.66 s, friction utilization saturated (max=1.0, p95=0.43→0.95), double_support increased, and capture margin remained negative. Decreasing pitch reference by -0.05R eliminated all falls (n_walking=4, n_fell=0), raised time_upright to 10 s, reduced pitch to ~0.03 rad, brought com_ahead_of_cop_over_L_end near zero (-0.0025) and improved capture margin (end -0.101).
